channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Dozens protest in Tokyo after U.S. Marine accused of murder in Okinawa
item.description: The case is the latest in a string of incidents going back years that have fueled unease over the large U.S. troop presence in Okinawa Prefecture.

item.title: Alcohol makers in Japan tap into U.S. ready-to-drink market
item.description: As the popularity of ready-to-drink products grows in the U.S., Japanese companies have introduced U.S. versions of such products in Japan.

item.title: Japan deal drought cuts IPO fundraising to lowest in 14 years
item.description: The development, amid regulatory changes and a dearth of AI-related companies, contrasts with a dealmaking boom across Asia.

item.title: Global banks bolster Japan debt teams as bond issuance booms
item.description: The boom in fundraising is being driven by mergers, acquisitions, and artificial intelligence capital.

item.title: Asahi and Kirin among Japan beer giants raided over alleged price-fixing cartel
item.description: Japan's Fair Trade Commission conducted searches of the country's largest beer-makers.

item.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
item.description: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
